source_locator: Page 17 of 17, TOTALS row, columns MAYOR DETROIT (Mike Duggan, Benny N. Napoleon, WRITE-IN)
verification_note: The scanned Wayne County Clerk precinct report for Detroit shows citywide TOTALS of 74,248 for Mike Duggan, 60,440 for Benny N. Napoleon and 455 write-in votes. Ballots cast were 135,929, so 786 ballots had no mayoral vote. Total mayoral votes are 74,248 + 60,440 + 455 = 135,143. The report was read by OCR and visual check of the TOTALS row. It is a Clerk document printed 11/18/13; it does not itself carry a certification stamp, so the status is source_verified.
total_votes_basis: sum of Duggan, Napoleon and all write-ins (455), citywide; excludes 786 ballots with no mayoral vote
